title: Provider directory scoreboard
note: Six metrics with a current baseline, each reproducible from public data. Stated so progress is arguable rather than felt. Recompute them against the next release with analysis/primer_scoreboard.py.

metrics.label: Endpoint attribution
metrics.question: Does the directory say who an endpoint belongs to?
metrics.detail: 16,262 of 110,973 FHIR REST endpoints name a managing organization.
metrics.headroom: 79.9% using only public vendor files that exist today.

metrics.label: partOf resolution
metrics.question: Does the organization hierarchy point at anything?
metrics.detail: 140,017 references to 43,551 distinct parent organizations. 140,017 resolve to a record in the export.
metrics.headroom: Publish the parents, or drop the field.

metrics.label: Organization typing
metrics.question: Can a consumer tell entities from tax records?
metrics.detail: 2,199,519 of 4,402,671 Organization records are tax-entity records carrying free text rather than a coding, against 2,202,028 provider records.
metrics.headroom: Give them a real code so they can be filtered.

metrics.label: Endpoint usability
metrics.question: How many endpoints can software actually query?
metrics.detail: 110,973 of 1,128,169 Endpoint resources are FHIR REST. The rest are Direct messaging addresses.
metrics.headroom: Not a defect. It is the right denominator to publish.

metrics.label: Affiliation coverage
metrics.question: Does the directory say where a clinician works?
metrics.detail: 100,918 of 230,837 active Pennsylvania practitioners carry a PractitionerRole. Coverage is uneven by profession, from 82.0% of advanced practice to 4.2% of pharmacy providers.
metrics.headroom: Publish role provenance so absence can be read.

metrics.label: Brand coverage
metrics.question: Can a patient's hospital be identified as itself?
metrics.detail: No brand or health-system layer exists in the directory. Nothing states that an organization belongs to a system a patient would recognize.
metrics.headroom: Vendor User Access Brands files are already public.
